newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.194 pct.
newsitem.headline: Swiss 3-month money market claims yield 1.194 pct.

text.p: The annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government three-month money market claims is 1.194 percent, down from the previous issue's 1.198 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
The latest issue, to be paid for on June 26, raised 812.7 million Swiss francs and was priced at 99.699 percent.
The previous issue, paid for on June 19, raised 1,143.50 million and was priced at 99.698 percent.
